Deep dives/Spurs/Victor Wembanyama

Signature move · San Antonio Spurs · No. 1

Denied by Wemby

His block, in motion: long strides to erase a lost step, a reach nobody else has, and the ball goes back the other way.

  1. Long strides. He erases a lost step in a few long strides.
  2. The reach. Reported 8-foot wingspan. He gets there first.
  3. Ball stops dead. Not a tip. It goes back the other way.
